info.name: Vertiv Environet Alert REST Alarms Data Sets API

items.docs: Returns the top-level list of data set entities available in the Environet Alert system. Each data set entity represents a category of infrastructure data such as groups, locations, racks, assets, devices, circuits, and points.

params.name: category
params.description: The data set category to retrieve

items.docs: Returns entities for a specific data category. Supported categories include GROUP, LOCATION, RACK, ASSET, DEVICE, CIRCUIT, POINT, Tenant, Maintenance, and ALARM.
